label: PF Backlog 44
title: Future: consolidate all stores (pipeline + dashboard) into a DB to enable RAG-based management
body: Owner note (P15): later, move ALL data (pipeline stores + dashboard control-plane) into a database, which would also enable better management/querying and retrieval through RAG (agent + chat companion grounding over projects, backlog, artifacts, telemetry, decisions). Not MVP-blocking; parked with follow-up. Requires a migration from the file-based truth contract (see BI-0025 legacy refs).
